lines.japanese: 夏。
lines.english: Summer.

lines.japanese: 帰路。
lines.english: The road home.

lines.japanese:
本日、忍は施設に顔を出すよう命じられている。
　与えられた仕事のはかどりは、順調とは言えない。
lines.english: Today, Shinobu had orders to report to the facility. The work he had been assigned was not exactly progressing smoothly.

lines.japanese:
だが同居している千鳥は、そのことで忍を責める
様子はない。
lines.english: Yet Chidori, who lived with him, showed no sign of blaming Shinobu for it.

lines.japanese:
もともと彼女は自宅にいないことが多く、ほとん
ど一人暮らしに近い。
lines.english: She was rarely home anyway, so he all but lived alone.

lines.japanese:
食料は業者が郵送してくるのを受け取るだけであ
り、生活費の支払い等も施設側が手配している。
　自宅の管理もまた忍の分担となる。
lines.english: Their food was delivered by a supplier, while the facility arranged payment of the household expenses and the like. Looking after the house was Shinobu's responsibility as well.

lines.japanese:
といっても、掃除やゴミ出しくらいのものだが。
　それでも多少は雑費というものがかかる。
　子供であれば買い食いくらいはするだろう。
lines.english: That amounted to little more than cleaning and taking out the trash. Even so, there were always incidental expenses. Any child might stop to buy a snack now and then.

lines.japanese:
つきあいで、そういったわずかな小銭が必要にな
ることもある。
lines.english: Keeping up with other children might also require a little pocket change.

lines.japanese:
誰かと話を会わせるために玩具を要することもあ
るだろう。
lines.english: Sometimes he might need a toy just to have something to talk about with others.

lines.japanese:
円滑に任務を遂行するため、裁量活動資金が毎月
口座に振り込まれているが、使用したことは一度も
ない。
lines.english: To ensure his mission went smoothly, discretionary activity funds were deposited into his account each month, but he had never spent any of them.

hyperlinks.preview: 9,750 yen per month. A sum meticulously calculated by the person in charge so it would not look susp

japaneseHyperlinks.preview: 9,750 yen per month. A sum meticulously calculated by the person in charge so it would not look susp

lines.japanese:
今日の出頭で、口頭による進捗確認がされること
は充分に考えられた。
lines.english: Today's summons might very well include an oral progress review.

lines.japanese:
お小言の一つも覚悟しておく必要が、あるかも知
れない。
lines.english: Perhaps he ought to brace himself for a scolding or two.

lines.japanese:
自らの有用性を示せないことは、冷たい組織に属
している者にとって苦痛である。
lines.english: For anyone who belonged to a cold organization, failing to prove useful was painful.

lines.japanese: ポテンシャル通りの機能を発揮しなければならない。
lines.english: He had to function to the full extent of his potential.

lines.japanese: 一刻も早く。
lines.english: As soon as possible.

lines.japanese:
歩む足取りが、自然とはやまっていく。
　忍が駆られていたのは焦燥という感情だ。
lines.english: Without meaning to, he quickened his pace. The emotion driving Shinobu was impatience.

lines.japanese: そういった情動が、少年の内に生まれつつあった。
lines.english: Such emotions were beginning to emerge in the boy.

lines.japanese:
例年、最高気温を記録しつづける夏。
　ふとした体調や気候の変化とともに訪れる、耐え
難い頭痛。
lines.english: Summer after summer, new record highs. Unbearable headaches brought on by the slightest change in his health or in the weather.

lines.japanese:
不快感。苦痛。焦り。
　端的に、忍は苦しんでいた。
lines.english: Discomfort. Pain. Impatience. Put simply, Shinobu was suffering.

lines.japanese:
これほど心を殺しても、生きるのは苦しい。
　もっと冷徹なものにならないといけないのか？
lines.english: No matter how much he deadened his heart, living still hurt. Did he need to become colder still?

lines.japanese:
だが心を殺せば判断が成らない。
　力だけを増幅するならいくらでもできるのだ。
lines.english: But if he killed his heart, he could no longer make judgments. If power alone were all that mattered, he could amplify it endlessly.

lines.japanese:
だが人間性は失われていく。
　いや……加速された果てに、肥大化した力は備わる。
lines.english: But his humanity would be lost. No… what waited at the end of that acceleration was power, swollen out of all proportion.

lines.japanese:
施設暮らしで幾度となく見てきた。
　力ばかり増幅し、ヒト種としての有用性を失う者
たちを。
lines.english: He had seen it countless times while living at the facility: those whose power grew and grew until they lost all usefulness as members of the human species.

lines.japanese:
今あるものをうまく使わねばならない。
　感情や判断も必要になってくる。
　楽で安易な手段などないのだ。
lines.english: He had to use what he already possessed with care. Emotion and judgment would both be necessary. There was no easy way out.

lines.japanese:
たまに、ごくたまに、全て投げ出したいと思うこ
とがある。
lines.english: Sometimes—only very rarely—he wanted to throw everything away.

lines.japanese:
そのような感情は危険であるため、忍は苦労して
打ち消さなければならない。
lines.english: Such feelings were dangerous, and Shinobu had to work hard to extinguish them.

lines.japanese:
千鳥は必要であれば忍を切り捨てることをためら
わないだろう。
lines.english: If necessary, Chidori would not hesitate to cast Shinobu aside.

lines.japanese:
まだ一週間目。
　時間はある。
lines.english: It was only the first week. There was time.

lines.japanese:
焦りに呑まれてしまわないよう、忍は自戒する。
　だが……ヒトの心は果てしなく遠い。
lines.english: Shinobu warned himself not to let impatience swallow him. And yet… the human heart remained impossibly far away.

lines.japanese:
自らもヒトでありながら、完全な理解を得ること
が出来ない忍だ。
lines.english: Human though he was, Shinobu could not fully understand it.

lines.japanese:
額の汗をぬぐった。
　暑さばかりで絞った汗ではない。
lines.english: He wiped the sweat from his brow. The heat alone had not wrung it from him.

lines.japanese:
頭蓋の奥がしくと軋んだ。
　頭痛の兆候を気取り、忍は憂鬱な気分になる。
lines.english: Something creaked deep inside his skull. Sensing the onset of a headache, Shinobu's mood darkened.

lines.japanese: そのタイミングで、事件は起こった。
lines.english: That was when it happened.

lines.japanese:
帽子が奪われたことを理解するのに、時間がかか
った。
lines.english: It took him a moment to understand that his cap had been stolen.

lines.japanese:
咄嗟に、反応しすぎてしまわないよう注意する必
要がある。
lines.english: In that instant, he had to be careful not to overreact.

lines.japanese:
普通、子供は緊急時に対応できない。
　すれば、場合によっては怪しまれるだろう。
　直感力に秀でた人間はいくらでもある。
lines.english: Ordinary children could not respond to an emergency. If he did, he might look suspicious. Plenty of people had sharp instincts.

lines.japanese: 改めて、状況を探る。
lines.english: He reassessed the situation.

lines.japanese:
数メートルの距離に立つのは紅緒あずさだ。
　非監視対象。
　貴宮家の隣家の娘。
lines.english: Azusa Benio stood several yards away. Not under surveillance. The Atemiyas' next-door neighbor.

lines.japanese:
……草原で、暴行されていた娘。
　忍はなりゆきで助けた。
lines.english: …The girl who had been assaulted in the meadow. Shinobu had helped her almost by accident.

lines.japanese: そして再会した。
lines.english: And now they had met again.

lines.japanese:
助けた時点で、彼女が隣人だとは知らなかった。
　回避不能の事態といえる。
lines.english: When he helped her, he had not known she was his neighbor. That made the present encounter unavoidable.

lines.japanese: （紅緒あずさ―――）
lines.english: (Azusa Benio—)

lines.japanese:
監視対象外……つまりＵＳＥＲではない。
　現象力を持たない常人類。
lines.english: Not under surveillance… in other words, not a USER. An ordinary human with no phenomenal power.

lines.japanese:
最低限のつきあいにとどめるべきで、かかずらう
必要はない。
lines.english: He should keep contact to a minimum. There was no reason to involve himself with her.

lines.japanese: だが少女はこうして忍にアプローチを仕掛けてきた。
lines.english: And yet here she was, approaching Shinobu of her own accord.

lines.japanese: なぜか？
lines.english: Why?

lines.japanese:
忍はいくつか思いを巡らせるが、満足のいく解答
は出ない。
lines.english: Shinobu turned over several possibilities, but arrived at no satisfactory answer.

lines.japanese:
二人は黙して見つめ合う。
　得体の知れない緊張が伝搬してくる。
lines.english: The two stared at each other in silence. An inscrutable tension traveled between them.

lines.japanese: 忍はそのまとわりつくような感触に、怖気をふるう。
lines.english: Shinobu shivered at the way it seemed to cling to him.

lines.japanese:
自分が今、何に巻き込まれようとしているのか判
断できない。
lines.english: He could not tell what he was about to be caught up in.

lines.japanese:
悪ふざけだと思われた。
　だが両者は決して親しいわけではない。
lines.english: It looked like a prank. But the two of them were hardly close.

lines.japanese:
悪ふざけとは、そのような関係にあっても介入し
うる行為なのだろうか？
lines.english: Did people play pranks even on someone they barely knew?

lines.japanese:
肌の感覚だ。忍の理解には遠い。
　ゆえに言葉を選べない。
　あずさもまた、何も言わない。
lines.english: It was something you felt in your skin, far beyond Shinobu’s understanding. And so he could find no words. Azusa said nothing either.

lines.japanese:
両名の間にわたされた緊張の糸が、どこまでも張
りつめていく。
lines.english: The thread of tension strung between them drew tighter and tighter.

lines.japanese: 限界を超えたのはあずさの方だった。
lines.english: Azusa was the one who cracked first.

lines.japanese: 「な、なにだまってんだよ」
lines.english: “W-why aren't you saying anything?”

lines.japanese:
肝のすわらない恫喝だった。
　ともかくあずさが先手。
lines.english: The threat lacked conviction. Still, Azusa had made the first move.

lines.japanese:
忍の方は対応を決めかねて、温度のない視線を向
けている。
lines.english: Shinobu had yet to decide how to respond. He merely watched her with a gaze devoid of warmth.

lines.japanese: 「ジャージ」
lines.english: “The tracksuit.”

lines.japanese: 「ジャージだけ、もらったって―――」
lines.english: “All I got was the tracksuit—”

lines.japanese: 「だから……その……おまえが……」
lines.english: “So… um… you…”

lines.japanese: 「その……えと……」
lines.english: “I… well…”

lines.japanese:
自らの動機を確定できず、押し潰されていくあず
さは、やがて言葉を失ってしまう。
lines.english: Unable to make sense of her own motive, Azusa wilted under the strain and eventually fell silent.

lines.japanese: そのタイミングで、忍は声をかけた。
lines.english: That was when Shinobu spoke.
“…What do you want?”

lines.japanese:
態度が冷たかったことが、あずさを燃焼させた。
　結果的に蘇生させたことになるが、忍は甲高い言
葉による反撃を受ける。
lines.english: Shinobu's cold response set Azusa ablaze. In a sense, it brought her back to life—but at the cost of a shrill counterattack.

lines.japanese: 「取った！」
lines.english: “I took it!”
“…Took it?”

lines.japanese:
「帽子、取った！
　ぼっとしてるから、とられるんだ！」
lines.english: “Your cap! I took it! That's what you get for standing around daydreaming!”

lines.japanese: 「返して欲しいか！」
lines.english: “Want it back?”

lines.japanese: どうでも良かった。
lines.english: It did not matter.

lines.japanese:
備品の管理など微々たることだ。
　損害にも打撃にもならない。
lines.english: Keeping track of one minor piece of issued equipment was trivial. Its loss would neither harm nor hinder him.

lines.japanese:
あずさの行為はまるっきり無駄であり、究極的に
愚かであったため、忍はそこに人間心理における整
合性を見いだすことができないでいた。
lines.english: Azusa's act was so utterly pointless, so supremely foolish, that Shinobu could make no sense of it as human behavior.

lines.japanese: 幼稚な言動。
lines.english: Childish words and actions.

lines.japanese:
今の紅緒あずさには価値がない。
　ただ未熟なものでしかない。
lines.english: Azusa Benio, as she was now, had no value. She was simply immature.

lines.japanese: （だけど……）
lines.english: (And yet…)

lines.japanese: 「返して欲しかったら……欲しかったら」
lines.english: “If you want it back… if you want it…”

lines.japanese:
泣きそうな顔。
　幼い忍の心中、急速に低下する驚異度。
lines.english: Her face was on the verge of tears. In young Shinobu's mind, her threat level plummeted.

lines.japanese: 「返して、欲しかったら―――」
lines.english: “If you want it back—”

lines.japanese: （あまりにも圧倒的な、それは）
lines.english: (It was so utterly overwhelming—)

lines.japanese:
消え入りそうな、種火。
　意味はない。
lines.english: A pilot flame, ready to gutter out. It meant nothing.

lines.japanese:
だが罪もない。
　死ぬこともない。
lines.english: But it was innocent too. Nor did it need to die.

lines.japanese: 「……あげる」
lines.english: “…You can have it.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「欲しいんなら、あげる」
lines.english: “If you want it, you can have it.”

lines.japanese: 背を向ける。
lines.english: He turned his back.

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、ちょっと！！」
lines.english: “H-hey! Wait!”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ……逃げるの……？」
lines.english: “What… you’re running away…?”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.japanese: 歩み去る忍のあとに、あずさがついてくる。
lines.english: Azusa followed in Shinobu's wake as he walked away.

lines.japanese: （まずいな、ついてこられると）
lines.english: (This is bad. If she follows me…)

lines.japanese:
つきまとわれることが一番困る。
　個人情報の漏洩経路は少ない方がいい。
lines.english: Being followed would be the worst possible outcome. The fewer channels through which personal information might leak, the better.

lines.japanese:
忍はその件で特に指示を受けてはいないが、警戒
はしておくべきだ。
lines.english: Shinobu had received no specific instructions on the matter, but caution was warranted.

lines.japanese: 組織の一員として―――
lines.english: As a member of the organization—

lines.japanese: （いや、それはないか……平気だ）
lines.english: (No, that won't happen… It'll be all right.)

lines.japanese:
本気で心配しかかった時、スイッチが入ったよう
に感覚が開けた。
lines.english: Just as he began to worry in earnest, his senses opened as if a switch had been thrown.

lines.japanese: そして、
lines.english: And then,

lines.japanese:
（あずさは僕に帽子を返してくる……
　そして立ち去る……だから平気―――）
lines.english: (Azusa is going to give back my cap… Then she'll leave… so it'll be all right—)

lines.japanese: （このまま歩いていけばいい）
lines.english: (All I have to do is keep walking.)

lines.japanese: （危険は、感じられない）
lines.english: (I sense no danger.)

lines.japanese:
直感はほとんど映像化されていた。
　いつでも見えるわけではない。
lines.english: His intuition had almost become an image. It was not something he could always see.

lines.japanese:
時折、未来の出来事が脳内に収束して、光景を再
現するのである。
lines.english: At times, a future event would converge inside his mind and reconstitute itself as a scene.

lines.japanese: PRECOGNITION―――
lines.english: PRECOGNITION—

lines.japanese:
未来視と呼ばれる力。
　存在する可能性が理論値としては予測されながら
も、有する者のいない力。
lines.english: The power known as foresight. Its possible existence had been predicted in theory, but no one possessed it.

lines.japanese: 神の領域に属する能力。
lines.english: A faculty belonging to the realm of God.
“…I'll give it back.”

lines.japanese: 果たして、幻視は現視となった。
lines.english: And sure enough, the vision became actual sight.

lines.japanese: （予知に現実が、追いついてくる……）
lines.english: (Reality is catching up with the precognition…)

lines.japanese: あずさは忍の頭上に帽子を叩きつけるように乗せた。
lines.english: Azusa jammed the cap back down onto Shinobu's head.

lines.japanese: 「……ばーか」
lines.english: “…Idiot.”

lines.japanese: とだけ告げると、反対側に走り去っていく。
lines.english: Having said only that, she ran off in the opposite direction.

lines.japanese: （それでいい……僕に関わると、不幸になる）
lines.english: (That's how it should be… Getting involved with me will only make her miserable.)

lines.japanese: また未来視。
lines.english: Another vision of the future.

lines.japanese: 連続して起こるのは珍しい。
lines.english: It was rare for them to come in succession.

lines.japanese:
みじかな映像。
　だがそれは決定的に結末を示唆している。
lines.english: A brief image. Yet it gave a decisive indication of how things would end.

lines.japanese: 紅緒あずさ。
lines.english: Azusa Benio.

lines.japanese:
どうでも良い存在である。
　仮に何らかの事情で死亡したとしても、忍が心痛
めることはない。
lines.english: She was of no consequence. Even if circumstances led to her death, Shinobu's heart would not ache.

lines.japanese: 冷徹な意志を揺るがすものではない。
lines.english: It would not shake his cold resolve.

lines.japanese:
任務・組織に対する帰属意識は強い。いや……幼い
忍の世界全てといって良かった。
lines.english: His loyalty to his mission and the organization ran deep. No… to the young Shinobu, they were the entire world.

lines.japanese: （だからこれでいい……そう思っていたはずなのに）
lines.english: (So this is for the best… I should have believed that.)

lines.japanese: なのに。
lines.english: And yet.

lines.japanese:
あの日、少年たちに暴行を受けていた少女の、悲痛
な叫びが意識から離れない。
lines.english: The anguished cry of the girl the boys had assaulted that day would not leave his mind.
